title: Create a folder — create_folder
text: api Sportity API key. Avoid writing scripts; store SPORTITY_API environment variable use Sys.getenv("SPORTITY_API"). password password series event. document_name Name folder, shown app. folder_id Id folder add document . NULL (default) uses root folder. event_id Id event add document . NULL (default) adds series. push_notification Send push notification users?
